neighbours.label: first-person 'will' / ''ll' offering to do something for the person addressed ('we'll call you back', 'I'll start cooking')
fire: Leave your number with the front desk and we'll call you back within the hour.
If you can hold the map, I will steer us through the narrow pass.
Just reply to this email and we'll send you a replacement part.
You gather the firewood, and I'll start cooking the beans.
Fill in the form below and we will get back to you shortly.
Bring the boxes inside; I'll sort them out tomorrow.
Tell me which size you need and I'll order it for you.
Wait at the corner, and we'll pick you up after lunch.
quiet: Guests left their numbers with the front desk so the manager had them.
He held the map while his brother steered through the narrow pass.
Customers who replied to the email received a replacement part.
She gathered firewood and her father cooked the beans.
Most visitors filled in the form below the entrance.
They brought the boxes inside and sorted them the next day.
She told the clerk which size she needed.
They waited at the corner until the bus came after lunch.

notes: Probe was weak: 'we'll check the status for you' 0.25, 'I will climb up' 0.17. Expect a possible fail.
